source.title: The Price of Hope
source.description: <Aeonas says nothing, he merely hands you the orb and turns away>
source.objective: Bring the Mannoroc Echoing Orb to Katherine the Pure in Stormwind.
source.progress:
Welcome back, <name>. What is that you have there...

Oh my.
source.completion:
That is quite the troubling tale. The part of me that is a <class> finds it impossible to reconcile that he willingly consorted with a member of the scourge... but the <race> part of me understands how strong the bonds of friendship can be.

I thank you for bringing the orb here. I will see that it is stored in the deepest vault we have for now.

Oh, One last thing, I had this repaired and had hoped to present it to Aeonas on his return. I think he would want you to wield it in his stead.
